description: This file defines React components for a UI Drawer, wrapping around the 'vaul' library's primitive components. It provides customizable drawer-related components such as Drawer, DrawerTrigger, DrawerOverlay, etc., for use in a Next.js project.

methods.name: Drawer
methods.description: A wrapper component around DrawerPrimitive.Root providing default data-slot and forwarding props.

methods.name: DrawerTrigger
methods.description: A wrapper around DrawerPrimitive.Trigger with a specified data-slot.

methods.name: DrawerPortal
methods.description: A wrapper around DrawerPrimitive.Portal with a data-slot.

methods.name: DrawerClose
methods.description: A wrapper around DrawerPrimitive.Close with a data-slot.

methods.name: DrawerOverlay
methods.description: Component rendering a styled overlay with animation classes, wrapping around DrawerPrimitive.Overlay.

methods.name: DrawerContent
methods.description: Component assembling overlay and drawer content with dynamic classes based on drawer direction, and rendering children inside.

methods.name: DrawerHeader
methods.description: A styled div for drawer header slot.

methods.name: DrawerFooter
methods.description: A styled div for drawer footer slot.
